  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.outcome = 'accept' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS ftr

  ON k.day = CAST(c.received_at AS DATE)
WHERE
  k.financial_quarter = 'FY2025/26 Q4' AND c.status = 'withdrawn'
LIMIT 1000

answer.explanation: Withdrawn applications received in FY2025/26 Q4 (January to March 2026).
answer.scope: All teams' cases; customer names hidden
